statusNote: Content status: draft. Every threshold is the simulator's provisional choice (E), awaiting review by an RDYC instructor (docs/VALIDATION_SHEET.md, section T). None is a syllabus value of any body.

seed.source: fixed so every learner gets the same water; varies the start headings

familiariseS.source: training slice brief section 7 (30-second familiarisation, not scored)

attempts.source: two assisted, two with less assistance (training slice brief section 7)

startTwaDeg.source: a close reach: the learner has to find close-hauled

headingJitterDeg.source: seed-varied start heading, plus or minus

cueHoldS.source: drawing again after the luff, held this long

tackStartTwaDeg.source: issue 47 (the turns lesson times a tack from TWA under 35 deg)

slowTackS.source: about 1.7 times the model's own reference tack (8.6 s in 10 kn, model output)

bigLossFrac.source: speed at the slowest under this share of the speed going in

ironsS.source: stopped head to wind this long counts as in irons

overshootTwaDeg.source: borne away past a close reach after the tack

recoverFrac.source: speed back to this share of the speed going in

recoverHoldS.source: course and speed held this long

slowRecoverS.source: from the end of the tack to course and speed

helpAttentionS.source: time without the goal before help level 1 (attention)

markDistM.source: a short beat: about 5.5 minutes in 10 kn in the model; at 400 m the shift's return came too late to matter (docs/TRAINING_SLICE_REPORT.md section 6)

shiftDeg.source: backing 15 degrees: a header on starboard (training slice brief section 8)

shiftRampS.source: the shift arrives over this time, not as a step

shiftHoldS.source: the shift lasts this long, then turns back over the same ramp: a temporary shift. A persistent shift gave no decision to teach in this model (both choices within 3 s)

decisionWindowS.source: a tack begun within this time of the shift beginning counts as responding to it (timed from where the turn starts); long enough to respond to the live help (its suggestion comes 24 s in)

roundingRadiusM.source: within this distance of the mark counts as reaching it

attempts.source: one with the shift overlay and help, one on your own

helpAttentionS.source: stuck time (from the shift's start) before help level 1; shorter than the beginner exercise's so that help comes inside the decision window
